text: Unit prices are set out in Schedule A and remain fixed for the term of this Agreement.
A change to a unit price takes effect only through a written addendum signed by both parties, and never retroactively.
Addendum No. 1 dated August 10, 2026: from September 20, 2026, the unit price of External SSD 1TB is changed to IDR 1,814,400.00 per unit.
This Agreement runs from January 1, 2026 to December 31, 2027.
The Agreement may be extended by written agreement of both parties.
